items.badge: 02 Nights / 03 Days — The Great Mara Discovery
items.title: The Great Mara Discovery
highlights: Journey into Kenya's most celebrated wildlife sanctuary where endless golden plains meet dramatic riverbanks. Witness prides of lions stalking through tall grass, cheetahs sprinting across open savanna, and massive herds of wildebeest grazing beneath African skies. WHAT'S INCLUDED Park entry fees ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Accommodation as per itinerary Meals as per itinerary (Full Board) Use of 4x4 Land Cruiser with pop-up roof Services of English-speaking professional driver-guide Game drives as per itinerary Complimentary bottled water in vehicle Government taxes and levies Day 01: Arrival & Masai Mara Pick up from your Nairobi hotel at 7:00 AM. Drive through the Great Rift Valley escarpment with a photo stop at the viewpoint. Continue to Masai Mara National Reserve. Check in at lodge/camp. Lunch. Afternoon game drive exploring the Mara plains searching for Big Five. Meals: Lunch & Dinner Day 02: Masai Mara Discovery Early morning game drive at 6:30 AM when predators are most active. Search for lion prides, cheetahs on termite mounds, and leopards in sausage trees. Return for breakfast. Optional Maasai village visit to learn warrior traditions and beadwork. Lunch at lodge. Afternoon game drive in the Mara Triangle sector. Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner Day 03: Departure Optional sunrise game drive. Breakfast and check out. Scenic drive back to Nairobi via Rift Valley viewpoint. Arrive Nairobi by late afternoon. Drop off at hotel or JKIA. Meals: Breakfast Max Guests: 10 Min Age: 5+ Location: Kenya Languages: English, Swahili Tour Type: Wildlife Safari

items.title: Savanna Secrets Safari
highlights: Uncover hidden corners of the Mara ecosystem across four immersive days. From the predator-rich Musiara Marsh to the scenic Mara Triangle and the wildlife corridors of Talek River.WHAT'S INCLUDED NOT INCLUDED DAY-BY-DAY ITINERARY Day 01: Arrival & Masai Mara Pick up from your Nairobi hotel at 7:00 AM.
